mages_legacy.lore.intro.title: The Mage's Legacy
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.1: The mage gave them to the earth. Mycelium grew through their bones and became a second blood.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.2: The Mycelids don't bury their dead, they plant them. A year later a grove of glowing mushrooms rises there, and in its quiet you can hear the voices of the ancestors.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.3: They say that somewhere under the roots of the world the mycelium still remembers the mage's voice and retells it to the Mycelids in their dreams.
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.tagline: Bonded beasts and echoes of the fallen
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.1: The mage gave them a voice that beasts and the echoes of the departed answer.
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.2: Shepherds build no houses: home is wherever the pack sleeps. They call every beast by name and remember every fallen one, and that is why the fallen answer.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.1: Disciples of the nameless mage who stood beside him as he split people into races.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.2: A splinter of that moment struck them, and time has run through them unevenly ever since. The Frozen rarely laugh: they have already lived every joy of theirs once.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.1: They offered the mage their blood in exchange for a long life. He took it and never gave it back.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.2: Since then their own blood leaks away like water from a cracked cup. The Bloodkin live by night, swear on blood and never drink from the same cup twice.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.tagline: The void and a pocket of their own
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.1: The mage led them through the first obelisk. They did not all come back: part of each of them is still there, in the void.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.2: To them the world is thin as paper. The Voidborn speak in whispers, because they hear something beyond the walls of the world answer them.
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.tagline: Bounty hunters of the mage's guild
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.lore.1: They served the nameless mage for pay: carried his staves, guarded the obelisks, killed whoever he pointed at. When the mage split humankind he paid them too, but in his own way.
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.lore.2: Mercenaries don't believe in gifts: whatever is given for free will one day be asked back. They keep their word while they're paid, and keep count of every debt, theirs and others'.
mages_legacy.race.tempter.tagline: A kiss, wings and other hearts
mages_legacy.race.tempter.lore.1: The nameless mage was endlessly lonely. When he split humankind, some were given his longing: the wish to be looked at, to be wanted.
mages_legacy.race.tempter.lore.2: Tempters are loved at first sight and can't be forgotten until the last breath. They say their kiss is remembered longer than one's own name.
mages_legacy.race.masked.lore.1: The mage gave them no face of their own. Instead he gave them the knack of taking others'.
mages_legacy.race.masked.lore.2: Beneath the mask there is nothing: no face, no name. The Masked know one another not by voice or eyes, but by whose faces they choose.
mages_legacy.race.masked.lore.3: Every face rots in time, and the Masked becomes no one again. So they are always hunting.
mages_legacy.lore.page.1: Once all people were one folk: weak, mortal and all alike.
mages_legacy.lore.page.2: Then came a mage whose name was forgotten before the first cities were built. He raised the first obelisk and through its eye saw what each of us could become.
mages_legacy.lore.page.4: So one folk became eight. The mage left, and no one saw where. But his gift did not vanish: it sleeps in the blood of everyone born into this world.
mages_legacy.lore.page.5: Today it wakes in you. Choose whose legacy you will carry. The choice is made once.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.gift: Some he gave to the earth
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.gift: To others, a voice for beasts and the fallen
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.gift: Some he bade pay in blood
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.gift: Some he led through the void
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.gift: His hirelings he paid in power
mages_legacy.race.tempter.gift: To some he gave his longing
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.3: The old ones say their first horn belonged to the mage himself: he blew it to call the people to the obelisk.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.3: They count days not by the sun but by sand, and in each of their houses stands a clock no one has ever wound.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.3: They say the mage still carries a vial of their blood at his belt. While it is full, no Bloodkin dies their own death.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.3: Each carries a splinter of that void, and sooner or later finds a home in it.
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.lore.3: There is still a light in the Mage's Shop. Who stands behind its counter no one knows, and the mercenaries say it's better not to ask.
mages_legacy.race.tempter.lore.3: Alone, they are cold. So they go where they will be seen, even if that is a battlefield.
mages_legacy.screen.asleep_desc: The strengths and weaknesses of this people have not awakened yet. The mage will return them in time.
mages_legacy.screen.ability_meta: Opens at level %s · key %s · %s Void · every %s s
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.1: Void: the race's resource, gathers by itself; faster in the dark, twice as fast in the End and the Pocket
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.2: The Pocket: a dimension of your own, a 5×5 island in the starry void; whatever you build and store there stays
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.4: You can sleep in the Pocket, and that sleep skips the night in the world too
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.1: Water burns, as it burns endermen
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.3: The world's beds don't hold them: they can only sleep in the Pocket
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.4: While walking through the void you can't strike or use items
mages_legacy.ability.pocket.name: Pocket
mages_legacy.ability.pocket.lore: A home that is always one step away.
mages_legacy.ability.pocket.desc: Opens a rift into your Pocket, an island in the starry void. Players standing right by you (3×3) come along. Press again in the Pocket to bring everyone back where you left from. You can only build on the island itself. Can't be entered for 5 seconds after taking damage. Leaving is free.
mages_legacy.ability.void_step.name: Void Step
mages_legacy.ability.void_step.lore: A wall is only the thought of a wall.
mages_legacy.ability.void_step.desc: You go into the void between worlds and in about 1.25 seconds fly through it up to 12 blocks where you look; your look isn't turned. Look at a wall or a ceiling and you come out in the first free space behind it, at your own height. Look at the ground or a slope and you come out on its surface (climbing up to 8 blocks). Never in stone or lava; bedrock bars the way. In the void you can't be seen or hurt, but you can't strike or use items either.
mages_legacy.ability.gravity.name: Heavier Gravity
mages_legacy.ability.gravity.lore: The void pulls everything near towards itself. Sometimes too hard.
mages_legacy.ability.gravity.desc: V: for 4 seconds a field of weight with a radius of 7 blocks surrounds you, its edge drawn on the ground. Once a second, with a heavy beat, every enemy in it takes 1 damage, is driven into the ground and slowed (Slowness I). Fliers and jumpers are dragged down. 25 Void, 18-second cooldown.

mages_legacy.refuse.busy: You are already on your way
mages_legacy.refuse.no_pocket: The Pocket is not available on this server
mages_legacy.refuse.pocket_hurt: Space still trembles from the blow: the Pocket won't open
mages_legacy.refuse.pocket_edge: Past the Pocket's edge there is only void
mages_legacy.refuse.bed: The world's beds don't hold you. Sleep in your Pocket

mages_legacy.talent.pocket.name: Pocket
mages_legacy.talent.pocket.desc: The Voidborn's core: a dimension of your own. The whole tree grows from here.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket.lore: A home that is always one step away.

mages_legacy.talent.void_step.desc: The basic ability of Through Worlds (key R).
mages_legacy.talent.void_step.lore: A wall is only the thought of a wall.
mages_legacy.talent.gravity.name: Heavier Gravity
mages_legacy.talent.gravity.desc: The basic ability of Gravity (key V).
mages_legacy.talent.gravity.lore: The void pulls everything near towards itself.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_1.name: Room I
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_1.desc: Your Pocket's island grows to 9×9. Everything built stays where it is.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_1.lore: The void gives way to those who live in it.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_2.name: Room II
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_3.name: Room III
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_3.lore: A small world nobody can take away.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cheap.name: Light Door
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cheap.desc: Entering the Pocket costs 10 Void instead of 20 and recovers in 5 seconds instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_guests.name: Hospitality
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_guests.desc: Players in the 5×5 around you go into the Pocket with you, not just the 3×3.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_vault.name: High Vaults
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_vault.desc: You can build twice as high and as deep in the Pocket: from 60 blocks below the island to 128 above it.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cradle.name: The Void's Cradle
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cradle.desc: A night slept in the Pocket fills your Void to the brim.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cradle.lore: The void rocks its children to sleep.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.name: Awakening: Rift of Space
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.desc: After a second the rift carries every enemy, pet and player within 25 blocks onto an indestructible 50×50 arena in the void for 60 seconds. Bosses stay in the world. Press again to end it early; the living and the loot go back to safe spots. The owner's death or leaving ends it too. 60 Void, 5 minute cooldown after the arena ends.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.lore: The world is too small for this fight. So you need another.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_regen.name: Quiet Arena
mages_legacy.talent.arena_regen.desc: Allies in the arena get Regeneration I.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_might.name: Arena's Fury
mages_legacy.talent.arena_might.desc: Allies in the arena get Strength I.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_ward.name: Arena Walls
mages_legacy.talent.arena_ward.desc: Allies in the arena get Resistance I.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_long.name: Long Rift
mages_legacy.talent.arena_long.desc: The arena holds for 90 seconds instead of 60.
mages_legacy.talent.step_far.name: Far Step
mages_legacy.talent.step_far.desc: The Void Step reaches 16 blocks instead of 12.
mages_legacy.talent.step_far_2.name: Through Mountains
mages_legacy.talent.step_far_2.lore: Mountains are only a thought too.
mages_legacy.talent.step_quick.name: Short Way
mages_legacy.talent.step_quick.desc: The Void Step recovers in 4 seconds instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.step_trace.name: Without a Trace
mages_legacy.talent.step_trace.desc: After a step, creatures within 16 blocks that were hunting you lose track of you, and for 2 seconds nothing farther than 4 blocks can notice you. Bosses aren't fooled.
mages_legacy.talent.step_ally.name: Fellow Traveller
mages_legacy.talent.step_ally.desc: Players within 2 blocks walk through the void with you, each to their own place beside you.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_worlds.des: The Awakening key shows everyone on the server. Choose one: two joined rifts open, before you and before them, for 15 seconds; players and their pets go through both ways. Distance and world don't matter. 40 Void a passage; a charge recovers in 2 minutes. Talents give a second and a third charge, each recovering on its own.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_worlds.lor: Every soul leaves a ripple in space. The Voidborn hears it across any distance, and knows where to step.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_long.name: Steady Passage
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_long.desc: The passage's rifts stay 30 seconds instead of 15.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_train.name: Caravan
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_train.desc: Any animal, and mounts with their riders, go through the passage too (your own pets always do).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_wide.name: Wide Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_wide.desc: The field of weight's radius is 50% larger (7 → 10.5 blocks).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_slow.name: Leaden Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_slow.desc: Heavier Gravity slows harder: Slowness II.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_pull.name: Attraction
mages_legacy.talent.grav_pull.desc: Every pulse of gravity pulls enemies towards you.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fliers.name: Earthbound
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fliers.desc: Flying enemies in the field are dragged down to the ground. Bosses resist.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fliers.lore: Wings are only a thought too.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_arrows.name: Bent Paths
mages_legacy.talent.grav_arrows.desc: Enemy projectiles entering the field lose their speed and fall.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.name: Awakening: Black Hole
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.desc: You vanish and become the heart of a singularity (the view steps outside meanwhile): 1.5 s it is born, 3 s it pulls enemies within 20 blocks, then the collapse: 12 damage to enemies within 6 blocks and 4 to you (never below 1 health). All the while you can't move or strike, but can be hurt; allies aren't pulled; bosses barely move; no blocks break. 50 Void, 5-minute cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.lore: The void inside you is hungry. One day you will feed it.
mages_legacy.talent.hole_wide.name: Event Horizon
mages_legacy.talent.hole_wide.desc: The Black Hole's pull reaches 25% farther (20 → 25 blocks).
mages_legacy.talent.hole_deep.name: Deep Collapse
mages_legacy.talent.hole_deep.desc: The collapse deals 16 damage instead of 12.
mages_legacy.talent.hole_quick.name: Quick Singularity
mages_legacy.talent.hole_quick.desc: The Black Hole gathers in 1 second instead of 1.5.
mages_legacy.talent.step_door.name: Open Door
mages_legacy.talent.step_door.desc: Pocket + Through Worlds. After a Void Step your rift stays open for 3 seconds: an ally who steps into it comes out of your second rift.
mages_legacy.talent.step_heavy.name: Heavy Exit
mages_legacy.talent.step_heavy.desc: Through Worlds + Gravity. Where you come out of the void, a weak field of gravity forms: enemies within 2.5 blocks are slowed for 2 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.door_recoil.name: The Door's Recoil
mages_legacy.talent.door_recoil.desc: Rift of Space + Gravity. When you come back from the Pocket, enemies within 4 blocks of where you appear are slowed (Slowness II, 3 seconds).
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.trial: Trial: grow the Pocket to 15×15 (Space II: %3$s) and sleep %2$s nights in it (so far: %1$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_worlds.tri: Trial: Void Step %2$s times through stone rather than air (so far: %1$s), %4$s of them in the Nether (so far: %3$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.trial: Trial: %2$s enemies must die under Heavier Gravity (so far: %1$s), %4$s of them fliers (so far: %3$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.refuse.singularity: The singularity holds you in place
mages_legacy.refuse.arena_here: Not here: space is already torn
mages_legacy.refuse.no_point: Remember a place first: Shift + the Awakening's key
mages_legacy.refuse.point_other_world: The remembered place is in another world
mages_legacy.refuse.point_far: The remembered place is too far

mages_legacy.talent.state.third_closed: The third Awakening stays closed: two of three can be opened

mages_legacy.guide.title: How the Legacy Grows
mages_legacy.scroll.lore: Give back to the mage what he taught your blood.
mages_legacy.scroll.desc: Right-click: forget every talent except the Awakenings and get their points back. Race and level stay.
mages_legacy.scroll.nothing: Nothing to forget: no talents learned yet
mages_legacy.scroll.done: Your legacy is forgotten: %s talent points came back.
mages_legacy.guide.points.1: Every race level gives 1 point, every tenth 2 more: 60 points by level 50.
mages_legacy.guide.points.2: The whole tree costs far more: choose your path. Cost grows with the tier: 1, 2, 3 points, an Awakening 5.
mages_legacy.guide.points.3: Experience for the same deed is capped every 10 minutes: a race grows by fighting and playing, not by farming.
mages_legacy.guide.points.4: The Scroll of Oblivion gives back every point except the Awakenings', to choose anew (paper, 2 eyes of ender, 2 lapis blocks, 4 amethyst shards).
mages_legacy.guide.awakening.1: The first Awakening opens at tier IV (level 30) after its own trial and sits on Z.
mages_legacy.guide.awakening.2: The second from level 45, after the mastery trial: click the second Awakening's node and its tooltip lists your race's three tasks. The trial takes you nowhere and is done in ordinary play, alone or with others. Then the second Awakening is learnt for its usual points and sits on left Alt.
mages_legacy.guide.awakening.3: Two of three can be opened. Each has its own cost and cooldown; they can be used together.

mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.2: Catch an enemy in Heavier Gravity
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.5: Kill a monster in the dark, the End or the Pocket
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.6: Sleep a night in the Pocket

mages_legacy.talent.state.tier_3: Tier III opens at race level 20
mages_legacy.talent.state.tier_4: Tier IV opens at race level 30
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_sanctuary.des: The Pocket opens 2 seconds after a blow instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_sanctuary.lor: Home doesn't ask whom you are running from.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hearth.name: Hearth
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hearth.desc: In your own Pocket you don't get hungry.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.name: Garden in the Void
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.desc: While you are home, crops, saplings and other growing things within 4 blocks of you grow about twice as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.lore: Even in the void something takes root.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_two_doors.des: The Pocket remembers where you entered it the time before. Leaving with Shift (Shift+H) takes you there instead of where you came from now, even to another world. Guests go back to their own places.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_two_doors.lor: Every house has a back door.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_shelter.name: Saving Rift
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_shelter.desc: When a blow leaves you at 3 hearts or less, the Pocket takes you (and whoever stands by) home at once. Costs 20 Void; at most once every 15 minutes; not with a boss within 48 blocks, not on an arena, not without the Void for it. A killing blow still kills.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_shelter.lore: The void doesn't give up its own.
mages_legacy.talent.void_eyes.name: Eyes of the Void
mages_legacy.talent.void_eyes.desc: In the dark (light 7 or less) you have Night Vision.
mages_legacy.talent.void_eyes.lore: Darkness is the colour of home.
mages_legacy.talent.step_soft.name: Weightless
mages_legacy.talent.step_soft.desc: After a step, 3 seconds of Slow Falling: step off a cliff or into the air and come down gently.
mages_legacy.talent.step_sense.name: Sense of the Void
mages_legacy.talent.step_sense.desc: Coming out of the void, you see every enemy within 12 blocks through walls for 4 seconds (glowing).
mages_legacy.talent.step_echo.name: Echo of the Step
mages_legacy.talent.step_echo.desc: For 3 seconds after a step the step key takes you back to where you stepped from — free, without restarting the cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.step_echo.lore: The void remembers where you came from.
mages_legacy.talent.step_ambush.name: Shadow of the Void
mages_legacy.talent.step_ambush.desc: For 5 seconds after a step, creatures notice you only from half their usual distance.
mages_legacy.talent.step_stone.name: Stone Path
mages_legacy.talent.step_stone.desc: A step that went through blocks, not just air, gives back 8 Void.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_cleanse.name: Soft Landing
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_cleanse.desc: Whoever comes out of your passage floats down gently (Slow Falling) and can't be knocked back for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_anchor.name: Footing
mages_legacy.talent.grav_anchor.desc: While Heavier Gravity holds, nothing knocks you back.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_drain.name: The Weight Feeds
mages_legacy.talent.grav_drain.desc: Every pulse of weight gives back 1 Void for each enemy held (up to 3 a pulse).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fuse.name: Heavy Fuse
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fuse.desc: Creepers under Heavier Gravity can't explode (unless set alight).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fuse.lore: Even a blast needs room to unfold.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_chain.name: Chains of Space
mages_legacy.talent.grav_chain.desc: Enemies held by the weight can't teleport (endermen, shulkers) and jump half as high. Bosses are unaffected.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_linger.name: Lingering Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_linger.desc: When Heavier Gravity ends, its field stays in place 3 more seconds and slows enemies (no damage).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_feast.name: Growing Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_feast.desc: Every enemy that dies under Heavier Gravity holds it 1 second longer (3 seconds at most per cast).
mages_legacy.talent.hole_sated.name: A Sated Abyss
mages_legacy.talent.hole_sated.desc: If the collapse strikes 3 enemies or more, you get 20 Void back. The recoil stays.
mages_legacy.talent.step_homeward.name: The Way Home
mages_legacy.talent.step_homeward.desc: Rift of Space + Through Worlds. Back from the Pocket, you can Void Step at once: its cooldown is reset.
mages_legacy.talent.step_rupture.name: Rupture
mages_legacy.talent.step_rupture.desc: Through Worlds + Gravity. Enemies you pass through during a step are shoved aside off your path and slowed for a second. No damage; bosses aren't shoved.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hold.name: Heavy Threshold
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hold.desc: Rift of Space + Gravity. While Heavier Gravity holds, the Pocket opens even right after a blow.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_2.name: Second Ripple
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_2.desc: Through Worlds gains a second charge. Charges recover independently.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_3.name: Third Ripple
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_3.desc: Through Worlds gains a third charge.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_3.lore: The finer the hearing, the more the roads.
mages_legacy.passage.title: Through Worlds
mages_legacy.passage.hint: Whom to open the way to?
mages_legacy.message.passage_to_you: %s opened a passage to you from the void: the rift before you, %s s.
mages_legacy.refuse.no_one: Nobody else is on the server
mages_legacy.refuse.passage_there: No passage opens there: that player is in a closed world
mages_legacy.talent.step_ambush.lore: Who steps out of the void stays in it a little longer.
mages_legacy.refuse.protected: This place is protected: the void doesn't lead there
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.1: Spores: the race's resource, gathering by themselves (1 a second)
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.2: Mycelium Network: living travel nodes for the whole server
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.3: Neurospores weaken and confuse enemies, Neurosymbiosis quickens allies
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.4: Innate: eats raw mushrooms and fungi (5 food and 3 saturation each); the diet in the tree makes fungal food stronger
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.weak.1: Fire and lava hurt half as much again
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.weak.2: Under the open day sun Spores gather half as fast
mages_legacy.xp.mycelid.1: Grow a node of the network
mages_legacy.xp.mycelid.2: Someone else travelling through your network
mages_legacy.ability.mycelium_network.de: H: at an own node, its settings and routes; elsewhere, the colony: nutrients, your nodes and "Grow a node here". A node grows on solid ground; the first is the Mother Mycelium (free), the next cost 20 nutrients, 8 nodes in all with the Mother. Your nodes closer than 256 blocks join by themselves; far ones (up to 6000 blocks, one world) need a grown thread: 1 nutrient per 80 blocks (5 at least) and a second of growth per 50 blocks. Any player of any race may use the network: a click on a node shows where it leads. A closed node lets in only its grower: no one else's way ends at it or passes through it. Feed it by clicking a node with mushrooms, fungi, bone meal, flesh or any food (Shift: the whole stack).
mages_legacy.ability.mycelium_network.lo: Wherever you walk, the mycelium is there already.
mages_legacy.ability.neurospores.name: Neurospores
mages_legacy.ability.neurospores.desc: R: a cloud of neuroactive spores, radius 5, for 6 seconds where you stand. Infected enemies get Weakness I and Slowness I, and each second have a 25% chance to lose their target and stumble; the infection lasts 3 more seconds after leaving the cloud. Bosses only feel the Weakness. No damage. 25 Spores, 20-second cooldown.
mages_legacy.ability.neurospores.lore: No need to kill. It's enough that the enemy forgets why it came.
mages_legacy.ability.neurosymbiosis.name: Neurosymbiosis
mages_legacy.ability.neurosymbiosis.desc: V: you, the allies within 6 blocks and your pets share symbiotic spores for 8 seconds: +20% movement speed, +15% attack speed, slowness removed. 30 Spores, 35-second cooldown. Allies are the players on your side: one Minecraft team; without teams, everyone until you come to blows (then not for 30 seconds); on a server without PvP, everyone but other teams.
mages_legacy.ability.neurosymbiosis.lore: One mycelium, one thought for all.

mages_legacy.talent.net_thrift.name: Thrifty Colony
mages_legacy.talent.net_thrift.desc: Nodes and threads cost 40% fewer nutrients.
mages_legacy.talent.net_reach.name: Far Threads
mages_legacy.talent.net_reach.desc: Your nodes join by themselves within 512 blocks, and grown threads reach up to 12,000 blocks. Nodes already grown look again by themselves.
mages_legacy.talent.net_train.name: Living Caravan
mages_legacy.talent.net_train.desc: Travelling through your nodes, players take their pets and leashed animals within 6 blocks along.
mages_legacy.talent.net_growth.name: Quick Growth
mages_legacy.talent.net_swift.name: Swift Threads
mages_legacy.talent.net_swift.desc: Journeys through your nodes are 40% shorter.
mages_legacy.talent.net_toll.name: Gift of Travellers
mages_legacy.talent.net_toll.desc: Every journey of another player through your node brings 2 nutrients.
mages_legacy.talent.net_sense.name: Watchful Mycelium
mages_legacy.talent.net_sense.desc: While you are online, monsters within 8 blocks of your nodes glow.
mages_legacy.talent.net_recall.name: Call of the Colony
mages_legacy.talent.net_recall.desc: Shift + the network key takes you through the mycelium to your Mother Mycelium from anywhere (even another world). Once every 10 minutes; not from a Pocket or an arena.
mages_legacy.talent.net_shared.name: Shared Mycelium
mages_legacy.talent.net_shared.desc: Your open nodes join by themselves with other Mycelids' open nodes nearby: the server's network grows together. The joins follow by themselves when a node is opened or closed; closed nodes stay out of the shared network.
mages_legacy.talent.net_glow.name: Glowing Paths
mages_legacy.talent.net_glow.desc: Whoever arrives through your nodes gets up to 4 food, never past 16 of 20 and once a minute a player. Travelling itself is never limited.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_bloom.name: Awakening: Great Bloom
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_bloom.desc: You root into the ground as a huge glowing mushroom for 15 seconds: allies (your pets and the players on your side) within 50 blocks heal 2 health a second (a heart), the mushroom itself 1 a second. The mushroom can't move or strike and can be hurt and killed; the view steps outside meanwhile. Pressed again, the Bloom ends early. Then 10 seconds of exhaustion. 60 Spores, 5-minute cooldown from its end, an early one too: leaving the server, death, rebirth, another world.
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_heal.name: Abundant Spores
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_heal.desc: The Great Bloom heals allies 3 health a second instead of 2 (the Mycelid itself still 1).
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_bark.name: Woody Bark
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_bark.desc: The mushroom form takes 25% less damage.
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_roots.name: Roots of the Colony
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_roots.desc: If the mushroom grew within 32 blocks of your node, the healing reaches 75 blocks.
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_long.name: Long Bloom
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_long.desc: The Great Bloom lasts 22 seconds instead of 15.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_wide.name: Wide Cloud
mages_legacy.talent.spore_wide.desc: Neurospores' radius is 7 blocks instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_wide_2.name: Spore Fog
mages_legacy.talent.spore_quick.name: Frequent Release
mages_legacy.talent.spore_quick.desc: Neurospores recover in 14 seconds instead of 20.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_long.name: Lasting Cloud
mages_legacy.talent.spore_long.desc: The Neurospore cloud lasts 9 seconds instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_spread.name: Contagion
mages_legacy.talent.spore_spread.desc: An enemy first infected by the cloud passes the spores to enemies within 3 blocks of it.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_confuse.name: Broken Coordination
mages_legacy.talent.spore_confuse.desc: The infected lose their target and stumble with a 45% chance instead of 25%.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_mark.name: Marked
mages_legacy.talent.spore_trail.name: Spore Trail
mages_legacy.talent.spore_trail.desc: The Neurospore cloud follows you instead of staying put.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feeble.name: Tremor
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feeble.desc: The infected get Weakness II instead of I (bosses still I).
mages_legacy.talent.spore_linger.name: Smouldering Spores
mages_legacy.talent.spore_linger.desc: The infection lasts 8 seconds after leaving the cloud instead of 3.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_storm.name: Awakening: Spore Storm
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_storm.desc: You release every stored spore (at least 50): for 10 seconds a storm of radius 18 whirls around you. Enemies are infected, get Weakness II and Slowness II and often lose their target; bosses only Weakness I. You and your allies (your pets and the players on your side) get Speed I and Strength I, and slowness is lifted. Then 15 seconds of exhaustion. 5-minute cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_long.name: Lingering Storm
mages_legacy.talent.storm_long.desc: The Spore Storm lasts 14 seconds instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_wide.name: Wide Storm
mages_legacy.talent.storm_wide.desc: The Spore Storm's radius is 24 blocks instead of 18.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_keep.name: Spore Reserve
mages_legacy.talent.storm_keep.desc: A quarter of your spores remain after the Spore Storm.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_ally.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
mages_legacy.talent.storm_ally.desc: Allies in the storm also get Resistance I.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_blind.name: Blinding Storm
mages_legacy.talent.storm_blind.desc: Every 3 seconds the storm blinds enemies (not bosses): they lose their target, lose their way and can't pick a new one for a second.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_pulse.name: Shared Impulse
mages_legacy.talent.sym_pulse.desc: Neurosymbiosis gives +30% speed instead of +20%, and Jump Boost I.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_reflex.name: Protective Reflex
mages_legacy.talent.sym_reflex.desc: The first blow on each one sharing the symbiosis deals 30% less damage (once a bond).
mages_legacy.talent.sym_unity.name: One Organism
mages_legacy.talent.sym_unity.desc: Neurosymbiosis reaches 10 blocks and lasts 12 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_adapt.name: Spore Adaptation
mages_legacy.talent.sym_adapt.desc: While the symbiosis lasts, nothing slows those sharing it.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_share.name: Shared Recovery
mages_legacy.talent.sym_share.desc: When the symbiosis ends, everyone sharing it heals 6 health (three hearts).
mages_legacy.talent.diet_1.name: Fungal Exchange
mages_legacy.talent.diet_1.desc: Fungal food (raw mushrooms and fungi, mushroom, suspicious and rabbit stew) gives 3 more food.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_env.name: Dense Shell
mages_legacy.talent.sym_env.desc: Fire hurts only 20% more, and under the sun Spores gather at the full pace, as in the shade.
mages_legacy.talent.diet_2.name: Deep Symbiosis
mages_legacy.talent.diet_2.desc: Fungal food (raw mushrooms too) restores 15 Spores.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_night.name: Night Growth
mages_legacy.talent.sym_night.desc: At night and underground Spores gather half again as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.diet_3.name: Living Recovery
mages_legacy.talent.diet_3.desc: Eating fungal food (raw mushrooms too) heals 4 health (2 hearts) at once — no more than once in 30 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_aura.name: Living Aura
mages_legacy.talent.sym_aura.desc: While your symbiosis lasts, allies coming near you join it.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rebirth.de: The Awakening's key by an own node (within 6 blocks) starts growing a reserve body there: 40 nutrients, 3 minutes; pressed again it tells how it is. One body only. A killing blow wakes it: you appear by that node (even in another world) with 30% health, fire, poison and wither cleared, then 30 seconds of exhaustion. The 20-minute cooldown runs from the moment a body starts growing. Without a grown body death is death; spores and other Awakenings' cooldowns are not restored.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_fast.name: Quick Body
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_fast.desc: The reserve body grows in a minute and a half instead of three.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_health.name: Hardy Body
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_health.desc: You have 50% health after rebirth instead of 30%.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_cheap.name: Modest Body
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_cheap.desc: The reserve body can be grown at any of your nodes without going there: in the colony's view (H away from nodes) click a node. Same cost (40 nutrients), time and cooldown; still one body.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_soft.name: Gentle Waking
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_soft.desc: A rebirth leaves no exhaustion of its own at all (exhaustion from the Bloom or the Storm stays), and for 5 seconds nothing can slow the new body.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_nodes.name: Spore Nodes
mages_legacy.talent.spore_nodes.desc: Colony + Neurospores. While you are online, your nodes give Weakness I to monsters within 6 blocks every 2 seconds (not bosses).
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feed.name: Feeding on the Infected
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feed.desc: Neurospores + Symbiosis. Every infected enemy gives you 1 Spore a second back (up to 4 a second).
mages_legacy.talent.heal_nodes.name: Healing Nodes
mages_legacy.talent.heal_nodes.desc: Colony + Symbiosis. While you are online, allies within 8 blocks of your nodes heal 1 health every 2 seconds (Regeneration I's pace; more nodes are no faster), but not in the 5 seconds after taking damage: the nodes mend after a fight, not during it.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_travel.name: Spore Wake
mages_legacy.talent.spore_travel.desc: Colony + Neurospores. Arriving through the network, you come out in a cloud of neurospores (4 blocks, 4 seconds).
mages_legacy.talent.sym_spores.name: Symbiotic Spores
mages_legacy.talent.sym_spores.desc: Neurospores + Symbiosis. Blows of those sharing your symbiosis infect enemies for 4 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.node_food.name: Fungal Larders
mages_legacy.talent.node_food.desc: Colony + Symbiosis. While you are online, allies within 6 blocks of your nodes get 1 food every 6 seconds, up to 16 of 20: no one starves at the colony, but healing still needs a meal.

mages_legacy.advancement.myc_bloom.desc: Heal a wounded ally with the Great Bloom
mages_legacy.advancement.myc_rebirth.des: Survive a killing blow through Mycelial Rebirth
mages_legacy.advancement.myc_perfect.des: Keep the Great Bloom and the Spore Storm going together for a whole second

mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.1: Blood: the race's resource (0–100), gathered by the hunt — direct blows on creatures with blood, the Harvest, the Blood Storm and the Sacrifice. No more than 20 blood from one creature, half from peaceful ones
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.2: Vampirism: direct blows heal 10% of the damage dealt
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.3: Thirst (under 20 blood): blows 20% harder and Speed I
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.4: Blood Dash, Harvest, Sacrifice and a Transfusion to an ally
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.weak.1: Blood drains by itself: 0.3 a second, twice as fast in direct sunlight
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.weak.2: The sun burns a bare head
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.weak.3: In Thirst and in the sun any healing but one's own blood is halved
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.weak.4: Ordinary food feeds only a third (not raw meat, see the innate traits); killing a creature with blood stills 2 hunger
mages_legacy.xp.bloodkin.2: Hit an enemy with the Blood Dash
mages_legacy.refuse.too_weak: Too little health: the sacrifice would kill you
mages_legacy.message.last_breath: Last Breath: your blood saves the body — you scatter into bats!
mages_legacy.ability.blood_dash.name: Blood Dash
mages_legacy.ability.blood_dash.desc: R: a rush of 10 blocks along your look; only walls stop it. Every enemy in the way (a monster, a creature hunting a player, or a non-allied player with PvP on) takes 6 once per dash — a direct blow: vampirism heals. Peaceful creatures and pets aren't touched. 20 blood, 6-second cooldown.
mages_legacy.ability.blood_dash.lore: Between a blow and its parry lies an eternity. A Bloodkin goes right through it.
mages_legacy.ability.harvest.name: Harvest
mages_legacy.ability.harvest.desc: V: blood is drawn out of every creature within 9 blocks but your allies (the undead too): each takes 4 and is pulled towards you; you heal 2 from each (10 at most) and drink up to 5 blood from each (30 at most; half from peaceful ones, 20 in all from any one creature). 40 blood, 20-second cooldown.
mages_legacy.ability.harvest.lore: Threads run from every heart around. All that's left is to pull.
mages_legacy.ability.sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
mages_legacy.ability.sacrifice.desc: H: 4 of your own health become 40 blood; 20-second cooldown. It never kills: with too little health it refuses. Looking at an ally (a player on your side or your own pet) within 8 blocks — a Transfusion: 25 blood and 2 health heal them 6 and give Regeneration I for 5 s, a player Strength I for 8 s too; 10-second cooldown.
mages_legacy.ability.sacrifice.lore: The mage took their blood in payment. They learnt to pay with it themselves.
mages_legacy.ability.feast.name: Feast
mages_legacy.ability.blood_storm.name: Blood Storm
mages_legacy.ability.night_prince.name: Prince of the Night
mages_legacy.talent.sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
mages_legacy.talent.sacrifice.desc: The Bloodkin's core: blood for blood. The whole tree grows from here.
mages_legacy.talent.blood_dash.name: Blood Dash
mages_legacy.talent.harvest.name: Harvest
mages_legacy.talent.night_eyes.name: Eyes of the Night
mages_legacy.talent.night_eyes.desc: At night and in the dark: Night Vision.
mages_legacy.talent.night_hunter.name: Night Hunter
mages_legacy.talent.night_hunter.desc: At night: Speed I and blows 15% harder.
mages_legacy.talent.night_lord.name: Lord of the Night
mages_legacy.talent.night_lord.desc: At night blows are 25% harder instead of 15% (and Speed I).
mages_legacy.talent.night_shade.name: Shade
mages_legacy.talent.night_shade.desc: The sun burns a bare head half as often.
mages_legacy.talent.night_sense.name: Blood Sense
mages_legacy.talent.night_sense.desc: The hearts of monsters with blood within 12 blocks beat through the walls: they glow.
mages_legacy.talent.night_cloak.name: Twilight Cloak
mages_legacy.talent.night_cloak.desc: The sun no longer burns the head (only Weakness I), dries the blood only half again, and healing in the sun is 75% instead of half.
mages_legacy.talent.night_hush.name: Quiet Step
mages_legacy.talent.night_hush.desc: At night monsters hunting you from farther than 8 blocks lose your trail.
mages_legacy.talent.night_blood.name: Night Blood
mages_legacy.talent.night_blood.desc: At night your blood doesn't drain and you get Regeneration I.
mages_legacy.talent.night_ambush.name: Ambush
mages_legacy.talent.night_ambush.desc: A blow at an enemy's back is 30% harder.
mages_legacy.talent.night_jump.name: Wings of Dusk
mages_legacy.talent.night_terror.name: Terror of the Night
mages_legacy.talent.night_terror.desc: A kill at night throws the monsters within 8 blocks off for 3 seconds: they lose their target and get Weakness I (not bosses).
mages_legacy.talent.night_feed.name: Night Feast
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_prince.des: An Awakening of two parts, both at once. Bat Swarm (the Awakening's key): the body scatters into bats for 3 seconds; the swarm flies where you look (20% faster at night), through creatures but not walls; ordinary damage can't touch it; no attacks, items or abilities meanwhile. 30 blood, 25-second cooldown. Last Breath (by itself): a blow that would bring your health to 10% or lower — a killing one too — scatters you into the swarm for 3 seconds instead, your health set to 30%. Day or night, no blood needed, once in 20 minutes; the swarm and the breath have cooldowns of their own. The void and /kill are not stopped.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_prince.lor: The night doesn't love its children. It only won't let them die before their time.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_prince.tri: Trial: heal %2$s health by vampirism (so far: %1$s) and make %4$s Sacrifices (so far: %3$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.talent.prince_long.name: Long Flight
mages_legacy.talent.prince_long.desc: The Bat Swarm lasts 5 seconds instead of 3 (the Last Breath's stays 3).
mages_legacy.talent.prince_swarm.name: Bloodthirsty Swarm
mages_legacy.talent.prince_swarm.desc: The Bat Swarm bites the enemies it flies through: bleeding and 4 blood from each, once per flight, 20 at most per flight.
mages_legacy.talent.prince_heart.name: Second Heart
mages_legacy.talent.prince_heart.desc: The Last Breath gives back 50% health instead of 30%.
mages_legacy.talent.prince_shadow.name: Shadow of Death
mages_legacy.talent.prince_shadow.desc: Back in the body after the Last Breath: Resistance I for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_reach.name: Long Dash
mages_legacy.talent.fang_reach.desc: The Blood Dash reaches 14 blocks instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_execute.name: Execution
mages_legacy.talent.fang_execute.desc: Blows on an enemy under a quarter of its health are 50% harder.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_double.name: Double Rush
mages_legacy.talent.fang_double.desc: For 3 seconds after a dash a second one is free.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bleed.name: Torn Wound
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bleed.desc: Direct blows and the dash on creatures with blood make them bleed: 1 a second for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_deep.name: Deep Wound
mages_legacy.talent.fang_deep.desc: Bleeding: 2 a second for 6 seconds and Slowness I (not bosses).
mages_legacy.talent.fang_leech.name: Greedy Fang
mages_legacy.talent.fang_trail.name: Blood Trail
mages_legacy.talent.fang_trail.desc: Each enemy the dash hits heals you 3.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bite.name: Bite
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bite.desc: Every fourth direct blow is a bite: 4 more damage and 4 health for you.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_frenzy.name: Frenzy
mages_legacy.talent.fang_frenzy.desc: Killing a creature with blood: Strength I and Speed I for 5 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_open.name: Open Vein
mages_legacy.talent.fang_open.desc: Your victims' bleeding feeds you blood.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_feast.name: Feast
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_feast.desc: 10 seconds of feasting: every direct blow heals you half its damage and drinks twice the blood; blood streams from the wounds to you. 30 blood, 5-minute cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_feast.lore: A hunger that can't be stilled can at least be fed.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_feast.tria: Trial: %2$s Blood Dashes hitting two enemies or more (so far: %1$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.talent.feast_long.name: Long Feast
mages_legacy.talent.feast_deep.name: Deep Feast
mages_legacy.talent.feast_sated.name: Sated
mages_legacy.talent.feast_sated.desc: A kill during the Feast: 10 more blood.
mages_legacy.talent.feast_share.name: Shared Table
mages_legacy.talent.feast_share.desc: During the Feast allies within 8 blocks heal a quarter of your vampirism.
mages_legacy.talent.feast_fear.name: Gripping Feast
mages_legacy.talent.feast_fear.desc: Blows during the Feast give Slowness I for 2 seconds (not bosses).
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_slow.name: Restraint
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_drain.name: Greedy Harvest
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_drain.desc: The Harvest heals 4 from each enemy instead of 2.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_harvest.name: Wide Harvest
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_edge.name: On the Edge
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_mark.name: Mark of the Harvest
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_mark.desc: Those the Harvest touched take 25% more damage from you for 6 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_sacrifice.des: The Sacrifice costs 2 health instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_hunger.name: Hunger
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_hunger.desc: In Thirst blows are 35% harder instead of 20%.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_vessel.name: Full Vessel
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_vessel.desc: The Sacrifice gives 50 blood and its cooldown is halved.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_rage.name: Rage
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_rage.desc: Killing a monster in Thirst: 15 blood.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_offering.name: Offering
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_offering.desc: After a Sacrifice vampirism is doubled for 5 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_blood_stor: For 6 seconds a storm of blood rages around you, radius 10: every second each creature but your allies takes 3, you drink up to 3 blood from each (15 a pulse at most; half from peaceful ones) and heal 1 from each (6 a pulse at most). 50 blood, 5-minute cooldown.
A harvest that doesn't end while anyone is left to bleed.
Trial: %2$s Harvests drawing blood from three enemies or more (so far: %1$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.talent.bstorm_long.name: Long Storm
mages_legacy.talent.bstorm_drain.name: Thirsting Storm
mages_legacy.talent.bstorm_drain.desc: The Storm heals 2 from each (10 a pulse at most).
mages_legacy.talent.bstorm_pull.name: Pulling Storm
mages_legacy.talent.bstorm_pull.desc: The Storm drags enemies towards you (not bosses).
mages_legacy.talent.bstorm_wide.name: Wide Storm
mages_legacy.talent.night_dash.name: Night Rush
mages_legacy.talent.night_dash.desc: Night + Fang. At night the Blood Dash costs half.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_harvest.name: Red Harvest
mages_legacy.talent.fang_harvest.desc: Fang + Thirst. Bleeding enemies give the Harvest twice the blood.
mages_legacy.talent.night_harvest.name: Dark Harvest
mages_legacy.talent.night_harvest.desc: Thirst + Night. At night or underground the Harvest costs 25 blood.
mages_legacy.talent.night_dive.name: Dive
mages_legacy.talent.night_dive.desc: Night + Fang. A dash begun in the air deals 50% more.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_frenzy.name: Blood Madness
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_frenzy.desc: Fang + Thirst. In Thirst the Frenzy lasts 10 seconds and gives 10 more blood.
mages_legacy.talent.night_drink.name: Strike from the Shadow
mages_legacy.talent.night_drink.desc: Thirst + Night. A blow at the back drinks twice the blood.
mages_legacy.mastery.goal.dash_chain.des: cut through three enemies or more with one Blood Dash
draw blood from five enemies or more with one Harvest
mages_legacy.mastery.goal.blood_tide.des: from Thirst (under 20 blood) back to 80 blood or more within 30 seconds
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_root.desc: The legacy begins: become a Bloodkin
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_thirst.de: Kill a monster with less than 20 blood
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_dash_thre: Cut through three enemies with one Blood Dash
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_harvest_f: Draw blood from five enemies with one Harvest
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_transfusi: Give blood to an ally or your own pet
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_storm.des: Catch eight different enemies in one Blood Storm
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_swarm.des: Scatter into a swarm of bats
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_last_brea: Survive a blow at the edge of death by scattering into bats
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_scarlet.d: Kill an enemy while the Feast and the Blood Storm both rage
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_gift.desc: Reach race level 5 and both basic abilities
mages_legacy.advancement.blood_first_cho: Reach race level 10 and learn a tier II talent
mages_legacy.message.mother_tutorial: The Mother Mycelium has woken! To feed the colony, take mushrooms, bone meal or other organic food and right-click a node. Shift + right-click gives the whole stack. New nodes are grown with H.
mages_legacy.network.feed_hint: Feeding: right-click a node with mushrooms, bone meal, food; Shift + right-click: the whole stack
mages_legacy.talent.innate.note: Innate traits need no learning: they are yours from the moment you choose the race, cost no points and stay through a talent reset. They work for as long as you belong to this race.
mages_legacy.talent.innate.click: Click to open the traits book
mages_legacy.guide.innate.1: The node beside the core holds the race's innate traits. They need no learning: they work from level 1, cost no points and the Scroll of Oblivion doesn't take them.
mages_legacy.guide.innate.2: The main tree shows what a character can become; the innate node, what it already is.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_void.name: Kinship with the Void
mages_legacy.talent.innate_void.lore: Space gives way to you where others must obey its laws.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_void.desc: Innate: 1 block more reach for blocks; your own ender pearl hurts half as much.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_void.effect.1: Spatial Grasp: you reach blocks 1 block farther (in survival 4.5 → 5.5) — breaking, placing, opening chests, pressing buttons, levers and doors. Attack reach and reach for creatures stay as they were; it doesn't reach through walls.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_void.effect.2: Kinship with the End: the landing of your own ender pearl hurts half as much (5 → 2.5). Ordinary falls, endermen, magic and any other damage stay as they were.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_fungal.name: Fungal Nature
mages_legacy.talent.innate_fungal.lore: What others call the forest's food is life itself to you.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_fungal.desc: Innate: raw mushrooms and fungi are food (5 food and 3 saturation each).
mages_legacy.talent.innate_fungal.effect: Raw mushrooms are your food: red and brown mushrooms, crimson and warped fungi (and other mods' mushrooms). Each gives 5 food and 3 saturation; you can eat them while hungry. Other races can't eat them.
A click on a mycelium node with a mushroom in hand feeds the colony, not you. Mushrooms are planted and crafted as always.
The diet talents work with raw mushrooms too: Fungal Exchange +3 food, Deep Symbiosis +15 Spores, Living Recovery 4 health once in 30 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_predator.name: Predator's Instincts
mages_legacy.talent.innate_predator.lore: In every living thing he hears a call. In every drop of blood, a promise of strength.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_predator.desc: Innate: you hear the wounded within 12 blocks; raw meat feeds better and never brings Hunger.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_predator.effe: Call of the Wounded: the nearest creature with blood under half its health within 12 blocks is heard as a muffled heartbeat from its side — quicker and louder as it nears — and a red pulse flares at that edge of the screen. No outline, no exact place: only the Blood Sense talent shows hearts through walls. The undead, golems, slimes and other bloodless are not heard.

Hunter's Flesh: raw meat isn't cut to a third and gives 2 food more than usual — beef, porkchop and rabbit 5, mutton and chicken 4. Raw chicken never brings Hunger. Raw meat gives no blood; cooked food still feeds only a third.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.5: Innate: 1 block more reach for blocks; your own ender pearl hurts half as much
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.5: Innate: hears wounded creatures within 12 blocks; raw meat feeds better and never brings Hunger
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.weak.5: Direct blows, the Dash and the Swarm drink no blood from the undead, golems, slimes, blazes, vexes and shulkers; the Harvest and the Blood Storm draw it from everything
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.perk.1: Hunter's Brand: a mark that gathers charges of Debt from your blows and bursts on the third
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.perk.2: Guild Harpoon: drag a light foe in, pull yourself to a heavy one or a wall
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.perk.3: The Mage's Shop: contracts, tokens and wares; a job done puts a fresh one on the board at once
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.perk.4: No mana: the abilities wait only on their cooldowns and work with no contract at all
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.perk.5: Innate: +10% damage to the quarry of a hunt in hand, and a faint chime from its side within 12 blocks
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.weak.1: Race experience comes mostly from contracts: random kills teach a quarter as much (15 per 10 minutes)
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.weak.2: Elite orders, discounts, better pay and more places open only through talents
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.weak.3: Weaker against players: a Brand bursts for 4 at most, blades hit for 2, the harpoon for 2
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.weak.4: The Last Ransom costs 30 tokens: without savings it saves no one
mages_legacy.xp.mercenary.5: The Mage's Learning in the Shop (3 a day)
mages_legacy.xp.mercenary.6: Kill a monster (up to 15 per 10 minutes)
mages_legacy.ability.hunter_brand.name: Hunter's Brand
mages_legacy.ability.hunter_brand.desc: R: a fast bolt of copper and gold, 20 blocks (never through walls), brands the first foe: 4 damage and the first charge of Debt; the brand holds 10 seconds. Every direct blow of yours on the branded one — weapon, your own projectile or the Harpoon — adds a charge (no more often than every 8 ticks). On the third the brand bursts: 6 more damage (4 at most to a player) and 2 absorption for you for 4 seconds (4 at most). The brand's own damage, its burst, blades and the banner add no charges. Never brands allies or pets. Cooldown 8 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.hunter_brand.lore: A debt can be forgiven. The guild never forgives.
mages_legacy.ability.guild_harpoon.name: Guild Harpoon
mages_legacy.ability.guild_harpoon.desc: V: a harpoon on a golden chain, 18 blocks. A light creature takes 2 and is dragged to you; a heavy one, a boss, a fixed one or a player takes 2 and you are drawn to it; a block — you fly to where it bit. Walls stop it, the pull lasts 24 ticks at most and stops against anything in the way; for a second after it there is no fall damage. A hit on a branded foe adds a charge of Debt (the third bursts the brand). Nothing to bite — nothing spent. Cooldown 10 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.guild_harpoon.lore: The chain is the same gold as the pay. It always comes back too.
mages_legacy.ability.mages_shop.name: The Mage's Shop
mages_legacy.ability.mages_shop.desc: H: the guild's book; the Shop's door opens before you. Contracts: the board (3 offers), the jobs in hand (2), pay in experience and tokens, handing items over, a fresh board for tokens. Shop: services and today's goods. A job done puts a fresh offer on the board at once; the whole board and the goods turn over every 20 minutes of play (sleep doesn't hurry it).
mages_legacy.ability.mages_shop.lore: The light in the Mage's Shop is still on.
mages_legacy.ability.guild_verdict.name: The Guild's Verdict
mages_legacy.ability.guild_verdict.desc: Awakening: a Verdict on a foe within 20 blocks for 15 seconds. Every second direct blow of yours on it calls a spectral blade (3 damage, 2 to a player), 5 at most. The sixth blow calls the execution: 8 damage (4 to a player), once. The condemned's death ends the Verdict. Cooldown 120 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.guild_verdict.lore: The warrant is signed. All that is left is to serve it.
mages_legacy.ability.life_debt.name: Life Debt
mages_legacy.ability.life_debt.desc: Ransom Awakening. For 10 seconds 40% of the damage that reaches you goes into a Debt (12 at most). Your direct blows pay it down by 20% of the damage dealt (30% on a branded foe). Paid off in time: +2 health and a golden wave, 4 damage to foes within 4 blocks. Not paid: half of what is left strikes you (it can kill). Shift + the key, looking at an ally within 12 blocks, signs it for them. Cooldown 60 seconds. The Last Ransom works by itself: a killing blow is bought off for 30 tokens — 40% health, once in 20 minutes.
mages_legacy.ability.life_debt.lore: Every blow can be put off. None can be undone.
mages_legacy.ability.guild_legend.name: Guild Legend
mages_legacy.ability.guild_legend.desc: Awakening: the guild's banner where you stand for 15 seconds, radius 10. You and your allies inside deal 15% more and take 10% less. Every 2 seconds it cuts up to 3 foes with spectral blades for 3 — branded ones first. Every foe you kill inside lengthens it by 2 seconds, 6 at most. Banners of several Mercenaries don't add up. Cooldown 120 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.guild_legend.lore: No one has ever lost under this banner. Those who did are not remembered under it.
mages_legacy.talent.mages_shop.name: The Mage's Shop
mages_legacy.talent.mages_shop.desc: Core: the guild's book (H) — contracts, tokens and wares.
mages_legacy.talent.hunter_brand.name: Hunter's Brand
mages_legacy.talent.hunter_brand.desc: Basic ability (R, from level 3): a brand gathers charges of Debt and bursts on the third.
mages_legacy.talent.guild_harpoon.name: Guild Harpoon
mages_legacy.talent.guild_harpoon.desc: Basic ability (V, from level 5): a harpoon on a chain drags a foe to you or you to your mark.
mages_legacy.talent.con_board.name: Wide Board
mages_legacy.talent.con_board.desc: The board holds 4 offers instead of 3.
mages_legacy.talent.con_hands.name: Second Pair of Hands
mages_legacy.talent.con_hands.desc: Three contracts in hand instead of 2.
mages_legacy.talent.con_elite.name: Elite Orders
mages_legacy.talent.con_elite.desc: Elite contracts reach the board (one at a time): twice the work, two and a half times the pay.
mages_legacy.talent.con_bargain.name: Bargaining
mages_legacy.talent.con_bargain.desc: Everything in the Shop and a fresh board cost 15% less.
mages_legacy.talent.con_scout.name: Tip-off
mages_legacy.talent.con_scout.desc: The quarry of your hunts within 32 blocks glows.
mages_legacy.talent.con_tracker.name: Marked for the Job
mages_legacy.talent.con_tracker.desc: Damage to the quarry of your hunts +20% instead of the innate +10%.
mages_legacy.talent.con_regular.name: Regular Customer
mages_legacy.talent.con_regular.desc: Two more goods in the Shop and two deals of the day instead of one.
mages_legacy.talent.con_partners.name: Partners
mages_legacy.talent.con_partners.desc: Kills by allies and your pets within 24 blocks of you count towards your hunts.
mages_legacy.talent.con_bonus.name: Bonus
mages_legacy.talent.con_renown.name: Renown
mages_legacy.talent.con_guide.name: Guide
mages_legacy.talent.con_guide.desc: An exploration taken shows the distance and the direction to the nearest such land (searched within 2400 blocks).
mages_legacy.talent.con_connections.name: Guild Connections
mages_legacy.talent.con_connections.desc: The first fresh board of a day is free, the rest cost half.
mages_legacy.talent.con_streak.name: Streak
mages_legacy.talent.con_streak.desc: A contract done within 20 minutes of the last gives 10% more experience and tokens for each in the streak, up to +30%.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_ransom.des: Awakening (Z or Alt): the Life Debt — put blows off and pay them down by fighting; and the Last Ransom — death bought off for 30 tokens.
mages_legacy.talent.ransom_write_off.des: When the contract ends, a quarter of the unpaid Debt is forgiven before it is settled.
mages_legacy.talent.ransom_guarantor.des: Your blows pay an ally's Debt down by 30% of the damage instead of 20%.
mages_legacy.talent.ransom_gold.name: Golden Reckoning
mages_legacy.talent.ransom_gold.desc: The wave of a Debt paid off deals 6 instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.ransom_second.name: Second Signature
mages_legacy.talent.ransom_second.desc: After the Last Ransom: Resistance I for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_far.name: Long-Range Brand
mages_legacy.talent.brand_far.desc: The Brand flies 28 blocks instead of 20.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_collect.name: Collection
mages_legacy.talent.brand_collect.desc: If a Brand's burst kills its bearer, the Brand's cooldown resets.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_compound.name: Compound Interest
mages_legacy.talent.brand_compound.desc: The brand holds 4 charges and bursts for 10.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_linger.name: Lingering Brand
mages_legacy.talent.brand_linger.desc: The brand holds 15 seconds instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_spread.name: Joint Liability
mages_legacy.talent.brand_spread.desc: A burst passes a brand with 1 charge on to the nearest foe within 6 blocks (a passed brand passes no further).
mages_legacy.talent.brand_pledge.name: Pledge
mages_legacy.talent.brand_pledge.desc: A burst gives 4 absorption instead of 2, up to 6.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_swap.name: Reassignment
mages_legacy.talent.brand_swap.desc: Branding a new foe carries the last brand's charges over to it (never enough to burst it at once).
mages_legacy.talent.brand_pierce.name: Piercing Shot
mages_legacy.talent.brand_pierce.desc: The bolt passes through its first mark and brands a second behind it.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_finisher.name: Final Instalment
mages_legacy.talent.brand_finisher.desc: A burst on a foe under 30% health deals half again as much.
mages_legacy.talent.brand_chain.name: Chain Settlement
mages_legacy.talent.brand_chain.desc: A burst also strikes foes within 3 blocks for half.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_verdict.de: Awakening (Z or Alt): one foe, a spectral blade for every two blows and the execution on the sixth.
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_long.name: Lengthy Trial
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_boss.name: Judging the Great
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_boss.desc: Blades and the execution deal 50% more to bosses.
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_blades.name: Seven Blades
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_blades.desc: The Verdict calls up to 7 blades instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_refund.name: Warrant Served
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_refund.desc: If the condemned dies by your hand, the Verdict's cooldown is 40 seconds shorter (once a Verdict).
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_triumph.name: Triumph
mages_legacy.talent.verdict_triumph.desc: After the execution: Strength I and Speed I for 6 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.harp_quick.name: Quick Winch
mages_legacy.talent.harp_long.name: Long Chain
mages_legacy.talent.harp_long.desc: The Harpoon reaches 24 blocks instead of 18.
mages_legacy.talent.harp_double.name: Double Throw
mages_legacy.talent.harp_double.desc: After a throw you have 3 seconds for a second one, free of the cooldown (once).
mages_legacy.talent.harp_stun.name: Stunning Pull
mages_legacy.talent.harp_stun.desc: The Harpoon hits for 4 instead of 2, and a creature dragged in is under Slowness III for 1.5 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.harp_precise.name: Precise Strike
mages_legacy.talent.harp_precise.desc: The first weapon blow within 3 seconds of a Harpoon hit deals 40% more.
mages_legacy.talent.craft_cuirass.name: Guild Cuirass
mages_legacy.talent.craft_bow.name: Guild Bow
mages_legacy.talent.craft_second_wind.de: Falling under 30% health: Speed II and Regeneration I for 4 seconds; once a minute.
mages_legacy.talent.craft_blade.name: Blade Master
mages_legacy.talent.craft_lifeline.name: Lifeline
mages_legacy.talent.craft_lifeline.desc: The Harpoon bites an ally too: you are drawn to them and both get 4 absorption for 6 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.craft_shoulder.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
mages_legacy.talent.craft_shoulder.desc: Your Brand's burst gives allies within 8 blocks Resistance I for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_legend.des: Awakening (Z or Alt): a banner that strengthens allies and cuts foes with blades.
mages_legacy.talent.legend_wide.name: Wide Standard
mages_legacy.talent.legend_ward.name: Shield Wall
mages_legacy.talent.legend_ward.desc: Under the banner damage taken is 15% less instead of 10%.
mages_legacy.talent.legend_blades.name: Fourth Blade
mages_legacy.talent.legend_blades.desc: The banner strikes up to 4 foes a wave.
mages_legacy.talent.legend_long.name: Steadfast Banner
mages_legacy.talent.legend_long.desc: The banner stands 18 seconds (kills still lengthen it by 6 at most).
A Brand bursting on the quarry of a hunt deals half again as much.
mages_legacy.talent.cross_tension.name: Tension
mages_legacy.talent.cross_tension.desc: A Harpoon hit on a branded foe gives its brand back its full time.
mages_legacy.talent.cross_guild_grab.des: A Harpoon hit on the quarry of a hunt cuts the Brand's cooldown by 4 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.cross_trophy.name: Trophy
mages_legacy.talent.cross_trophy.desc: A branded quarry you kill counts twice towards its hunt.
mages_legacy.talent.cross_rhythm.name: Rhythm of the Hunt
mages_legacy.talent.cross_rhythm.desc: A Brand's burst cuts the Harpoon's cooldown by 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.cross_silver.name: Silver Guarantee
mages_legacy.talent.cross_silver.desc: A contract done: +6 health, the Harpoon ready again, and a running Life Debt 4 smaller.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_verdict.lo: The guild doesn't take revenge. The guild serves warrants.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_ransom.lor: Everything has a price. Even the last breath.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_legend.lor: A banner isn't raised for the foe to see. It is raised for one's own.

mages_legacy.talent.innate_profit.name: A Nose for Profit
mages_legacy.talent.innate_profit.lore: A Mercenary smells the quarry before seeing it. Especially the one already paid for.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_profit.desc: Innate: +10% damage to the quarry of your hunts; the nearest such quarry within 12 blocks can be heard.
mages_legacy.talent.innate_profit.effect: A price on its head: you hit creatures your hunts are after 10% harder. The talent Marked for the Job raises it to 20%, not 30%.

The chink of coins: every 2 seconds the nearest such quarry within 12 blocks answers with a faint metallic chime from its side, and a golden glint flashes at the screen's edge on that side. No coordinates, no glow through walls — that is the talent Tip-off's work.
